name: aesthetic-dna
description: 审美判断：网页、落地页、海报、宣传视频的高级感与土不土。 Covers premium look for websites and landing pages, posters, music video and product promo direction, cinematic image prompts, and a check for cheap-looking execution of contested elements by style. Use it with design-workflow when building a site; use it alone to judge whether a poster, page or prompt looks cheap.
author: Artemis
